Name: SMAPI Silent Launcher
Author: Yousv
Description:
[center][size=6][b]SMAPI Silent Launcher[/b][/size]
[color=#aaaaaa]No more console window. Just the game.[/color][/center]
[line]
Replaces the SMAPI console window with a small overlay that fades in while the game loads, then disappears. Nothing else changes.
[line]
[size=4][b][color=#e8a87c]Features[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]No console window on launch[/*]
[*]Status overlay shows mod and content pack counts, with a live countdown timer[/*]
[*]Double-right-click the overlay to abort the launch[/*]
[*]Configurable timeout via [b]--timeout N[/b], defaults to 100 seconds[/*]
[*]Supports custom mod folder paths via [b]--mods-path[/b][/*]
[*]Detects SMAPI crashes during launch instead of hanging[/*]
[*]Refuses to launch if SMAPI or another launcher instance is already running[/*]
[*]Writes a log file next to the exe if SMAPI crashes or times out[/*]
[*]Steam achievements, overlay, and playtime tracking all work fine[/*]
[*]No dependencies, no installs, single exe[/*]
[*]Does not modify SMAPI, the game, or any mods[/*]
[/list][line]
[size=4][b][color=#e8a87c]Installation[/color][/b][/size]
Drop [b]SMAPI SilentLauncher.exe[/b] into your Stardew Valley folder, the same folder as [b]StardewModdingAPI.exe[/b].
[b]Steam[/b]
Go to Stardew Valley in your Steam library, right-click [b]Properties > General > Launch Options[/b] and set:
[code]"<GameDirectory>\SMAPI SilentLauncher.exe" --mods-path "mods" --timeout 100 %command% [/code]Example (change "mods" to your modpack's folder name if it differs):
[code]"D:\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\SMAPI SilentLauncher.exe" --mods-path "mods" --timeout 100 %command%[/code]Launching this way counts identically to launching SMAPI directly, so Steam achievements, overlay, and playtime all stay active.
[b]Shortcut / other launcher[/b]
Point it at [b]SMAPI SilentLauncher.exe[/b] and pass any arguments you normally would. They get forwarded to SMAPI as-is. Supports [b]--mods-path[/b] and [b]--timeout N[/b].
[line]
[size=4][b][color=#e8a87c]Antivirus Warnings[/color][/b][/size]
Windows SmartScreen may warn you on first run since the exe is not code-signed. Hit [b]More info > Run anyway[/b].
Some antivirus tools may also flag it. The launcher hides the console window using a technique that overlaps with how some malware behaves, even though nothing malicious is going on here. Full source on [url=https://github.com/yousv/SMAPI-SilentLauncher]GitHub[/url].
[line]
[size=4][b][color=#e8a87c]Errors[/color][/b][/size]
[b]"Wrong folder"[/b] - Move [b]SMAPI SilentLauncher.exe[/b] next to [b]Stardew Valley.exe[/b]
[b]"SMAPI is not installed"[/b] - Install SMAPI from [url=https://smapi.io]smapi.io[/url]
[b]"Already running"[/b] - Close the game or SMAPI first, or check if another instance of the launcher is active
[b]"SMAPI closed before the game started"[/b] - SMAPI crashed or exited during launch, check SMAPI's log and [b]smapi-silent-launcher.log[/b] for details
[b]"Launch timed out"[/b] - The default timeout expired, increase it with [b]--timeout N[/b] if you have a large modpack
[line]
If you run into anything else, please post it on the Bugs tab so it can get looked at.
[line]
